mapper.select: SELECT banner_id AS bannerId, banner_title AS title, COALESCE(image_url, '') AS imageUrl, target_project_id AS targetProjectId, target_session_id AS targetSessionId, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM banner_item b JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = b.target_project_id LEFT JOIN performance_session s ON s.session_id = b.target_session_id AND s.project_id = b.target_project_id WHERE b.enable_status = 'ENABLED' AND b.start_time <= NOW() AND b.end_time >= NOW() AND p.project_status <> 'OFFLINE' AND ( b.target_session_id IS NULL OR s.session_status <> 'OFFLINE' ) ORDER BY b.sort_order ASC, b.banner_id ASC

SELECT category_id AS categoryId, category_code AS categoryCode, category_name AS categoryName, COALESCE(icon_url, '') AS iconUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM category ORDER BY sort_order ASC, category_id ASC

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, s.session_id AS sessionId, p.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, p.title AS title, COALESCE(p.poster_url, '') AS posterUrl, s.city_name AS cityName, v.venue_name AS venueName, s.start_time AS startTime, s.min_price AS minPrice, s.max_price AS maxPrice, p.hot_score AS hotScore, p.want_count AS wantCount FROM performance_session s JOIN performance_project p ON p.project_id = s.project_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = s.venue_id WHERE s.session_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku WHERE ready_sku.session_id = s.session_id AND ready_sku.sku_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND ready_sku.stock_available > 0 ) AND s.start_time >= NOW() AND s.start_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND p.project_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'COMING_SOON') AND p.recommend_flag = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM performance_session s2 WHERE s2.project_id = s.project_id AND s2.session_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_sku ready_sku2 WHERE ready_sku2.session_id = s2.session_id AND ready_sku2.sku_status IN ('ON_SALE', 'PRESALE') AND ready_sku2.stock_available > 0 ) AND s2.start_time >= NOW() AND s2.start_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND ( s2.start_time < s.start_time OR (s2.start_time = s.start_time AND s2.session_id < s.session_id) ) ) ORDER BY p.hot_score DESC, p.want_count DESC, s.start_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
